question: Brief me for the 10:00 Nordvik redline call

intro.title: Welcome to The Floor
intro.text: Jonas Lindqvist runs Mediacorp's EMEA desk like a trading floor. Nine deals, $3.4M, one signature — the whole quarter on a single scoreboard.

hero.title: Countdown, thermometer, river
hero.text: OPP-4821's $1.2M spotlight counts down live to Aug 21; the quota thermometer sits at 48.2%; beneath, the $18.6M pipeline river flows through five lanes.

kpis.title: Four naked stats
kpis.text: The stat strip, straight off Salesforce: attainment 48.2%, coverage 3.1x, nine August deals, $186K average size — every sparkline live, every card draggable.

chart.title: Chapter 01: The truth
chart.text: One full-bleed chart tells the year: June spiked to 127% on Nordvik's pilot, July dipped to 83%, and August already holds $1.42M booked.

ask.title: Drag the deal, ask
ask.text: Drag the spotlight board into chat — askMElah pulls Salesforce, Gmail, and Drive, then briefs the 10:00 Nordvik redline call in seconds.

delegate.title: Runners on the floor
delegate.text: In Momentum, runners work the phones: hand askMElah the Aventra security-questionnaire chase and watch it keep the $840K September signature alive.

crew.title: Bolt takes the handoff
crew.text: Delegate the Aventra chase and The Crew opens: Jonas's agent Bolt walks the task to the askMElah hub solo, tool calls riding up and results hopping back, then delivers the answer straight to his desk.

autopilot.title: Autopilot stamps the desk
autopilot.text: On the Commit desk, flip Autopilot: low-risk lines stamp CLEARED — Sofia's $1,840 dinner clears itself. The 18% Trellis override still waits for Jonas.

mcp.title: Wired into everything
mcp.text: The wired-into rail shows eight live connections — Salesforce, DocuSign, Gmail and more. Open the MCP console: every number traces back to a source.

recap.title: The week, one button
recap.text: One masthead button drafts the recap: Caldera executed at $290K, commit up $310K, slip risks flagged — Claire's report before the desk closes at 18:00.

outro.title: The floor closes green
outro.text: The Floor keeps the quarter honest; Jonas keeps selling. A $1.2M signature is thirteen days out — and this is one desk at Mediacorp.
